items.title: competence_floor R4 819a: reconcile worst-seed non-vacuity gate with strict-majority router + recalibrate 1.0 floor/margin (MECH-457/INV-088 z_world instrument-validity)
items.note: SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-819. TEST-DESIGN FIX (measurement_test_design_defect adjudicated in failure_autopsy_batch-793a-817-819_2026-07-26.md target 3, user-confirmed 2026-07-26). The 819 run's non-vacuity GATE and routing PREDICATE disagreed on the same data: post_bc_install_took scored install on the WORST seed (trained 0.9 vs 1.0 on seed 43, a 0.1 near-miss; random 0.4) so BOTH arms went red and the run was vacated zworld_advantage_grid_nondiscriminative, while the router's strict-majority install_took (trained 2/3, random 0/3) read an asymmetric-install advantage (headline.advantage_confirmed=true). The z_world encoder DID train (819 world_encoder_max_abs_delta 0.277-0.333, 3/3 seeds; V3-EXQ-780 frozen-random-projection fault stays fixed). THREE FIXES, all measurement (substrate + science unchanged): (1) post_bc_install_took now scored on the STRICT-MAJORITY install FRACTION (>0.5), the IDENTICAL predicate the router uses, so gate==router by construction and a non-installing control (0.0) never vacates the trained arm (0.667 green) -- realising the precondition's own 'NON-vacating per-arm' docstring; per-seed install stays at the 1.0 substrate floor (the defect was worst-seed aggregation, not the floor value). (2) ADVANTAGE_ABS_FLOOR 1.0->0.3, rescaled to the 0.35-2.4 res/ep near-floor band (~2% of the 48.05 local_view / 57.2 oracle ceiling; 819's 1.0 margin demanded a near-doubling and dominated the 0.15 relative bar). (3) seeds 3->6 (42..47), matching the 793a repower, for a firmer 4/6 strict-majority (with fix 1 a single seed no longer vacates under any rule). RE-DERIVE BRAKE DOES NOT FIRE: under R3 only genuine substrate_ceiling autopsies count and MECH-457/INV-088 have ZERO (whole campaign is competence_implementation_gap/measurement_test_design_defect); a test-design fix of an already-run leg is not a same-question ceiling re-pose. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = reconciled trained-vs-random z_world competence at strict-majority over 6 seeds; 819 vacated the run and recorded no such scored readout -> must run. DIAGNOSTIC (claim_ids MECH-457+INV-088 excluded from scoring; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING; route to /failure-autopsy). Resolves the pre-registered competence_floor R4 frozen-ledger leg H-zworld-trained-instrument (alive, awaiting a scored run). Reference build 128/3x/detached (NOT 769-falsified 256/5x). CONTROL arm (zworld_random_proj) mints reuse-eligible (include_driver_script_in_hash=False, shared lineage slice). Smoke PASS (dry-run full pipeline: encoder trains on trained arm, guard fires non-gating on control, eff_margin=0.3 live); validate_experiments/validate_recording --strict OK.

items.title: SD-080 world-effect grounding CAPABILITY falsifier (817 successor: learnable next-state grounding + robust M5/fit gate)
items.note: Successor to V3-EXQ-817 (SD-080 world-effect-grounding CAPABILITY falsifier). Per failure_autopsy_batch-793a-817-819_2026-07-26 target 2: 817's self-route 'substrate_not_ready' was a MISNOMER -- the ao head trained (delta_l2 ~1.3-1.47) but the delta-prediction objective did not induce the geometry (M5 0.994->0.982, M6 0.085). TWO FIXES, both calibration-driven (this script, seeds 0/1, 2026-07-26): (1) STRONGER OBJECTIVE -- regress o_t (no trainable readout) onto a fixed near-isometric projection of the REALISED next world-state z_world_{t+1} (the learnable latent world-effect world_forward itself predicts). Calibration: ARM_1 M5 0.99->0.70 with real fit (MSE 0.64-0.77), SHUFFLED control stays ~0.99. Two rejected objectives recorded in docstring (relational/contrastive = scale-invariant, cannot move M5; dense-consequence regression = only ~20pct predictable from z_world). (2) RECALIBRATED GATE -- calibration showed the M6 floor is NOT mis-set but NOISE-DOMINATED (frozen ao M6 -0.18..+0.13 by seed; world_forward M6 0.07-0.22; shuffled hit 0.21). Gate moved OFF absolute M6 to robust low-noise signals: world-effect FIT + ARM_1 state-dependence (M5 drop, paired) + ARM_2-vs-ARM_1 content discrimination. M6 recorded, not gated. Poor fit self-routes to a distinct SUBSTRATE label (worldeffect_ungroundable_from_zworld), separable from objective failure. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = behavioural harm_rate/survival under a GROUNDED O; 817 never produced it (gate never fired), and the world-effect-grounded manipulation exists in no recorded manifest -> not recoverable, run. Re-derive brake: SD-080=1 / SD-004=1 (< threshold 2; the single hit is this routing autopsy, category competence_implementation_gap, not a ceiling) -> not braked. SD-080 frozen-projection defect stays CONFIRMED via 809; 817a adds the orthogonal CAPABILITY read. Substrate fully built (817 ran). Smoke PASS; validate_experiments/recording --strict clean. supersedes V3-EXQ-817.
